--the seven chief sages of whom भृगु was the chief;
1: भा. IV. २१. १३;
--the Goddess enshrined in चित्त or wisdom. M. १३. ५३.
--the period when ब्रह्मा was born. भा.
--when ब्रह्मा was known as शब्द- brahman. भा. III. ११. ३४.
--a महातीर्थ founded by ब्रह्मा in olden days in कुरुक्षेत्र; famous as the place of origin for the वायु पुराण: the home of the seven sages. वा. ५९. १०६-7; ९७. 5.

--Vedic chanting;
1: M. २५६. 8.
in connection with the founding of temples.
2: Ib. २६४. ३४.
--a son of क्रोधा and a Devagandharva. Br.

--duties of: with a दण्ड and tuft, bed on the earth over skin, service to Guru, learning and living on alms;
1: भा. VII. १२ (whole), XI. १८. ४२-3; Br.

-7.
may remain so throughout life by taking to वैखानस or परिव्रताश्रम.
2: Ib. III. १०. १४-15.

--clouds out of the breath of ब्रह्मा; they cause thunder and lightning; by them the earth attains youthhood; chief among them are the जीमूत which rain from a distance of a Yojana and a half. वा. ५१. २८, ३४-7.
--(see वसुर्धाम): Vasu, located at ब्रह्मस्थानम्. Br. II. १२. २५. वा. २९. २१.
--one of the four means of attaining मुक्ति। वा. १०५. १६.
--the sages who were born of ब्रह्मा's heart, ears, eyes, breath etc. वा. 9. १००-3.
--to be worshipped for increase of ब्रह्मवर्चस्। भा.

--(ब्रह्मतुङ्गहृद वा। प्।) a sacred तीर्थ near यमुना: Here वसिष्ठ performed तपस् standing like a pillar;
1: Br. III. १३. ७३.
fit for श्राद्ध; bathing once here makes a man a ब्रह्मा; there is a तुला (balance) at the place to measure one's righteousness or sins.
2: वा. ७७. ७१-3.

--the rod of punishment of the creator;
1: M. २४५. 2; २४९. ६५.
the punishment to the Sagaras; they live in hell.
2: Br. III. ५३. ४५; ५४. 8, २५; ५६. ३५.
(II)--the son of अणुह and कीर्तिमती. Br.

(III)--the son of विभ्राज, the पाञ्चाल king; in previous birth पितृवर्ति (s.v.), a son of कौशिक; his queen Sannati, daughter of Devala, being in one of her previous births the cow of Garga, was killed by कौशिक's sons during a famine; was anointed the पाञ्चाल king, and his two brothers in his previous birth, became his ministers; [page२-507+ २९] both king and queen once visited the pleasure garden and were taken by surprise at the sight of the love quarrels between two ants who were husband and wife; the wife accused the husband of taking pieces of मोदक (sweet- meat) to a neighbouring lady-love, an ant; the husband confessed that it was offered so thinking that she was her- self, his own wife and that he would behave more carefully in future; B. understood this as he could follow the language of all insects by divine grace; when Sannati thought that the king laughed at her and took it seriously, he took a vow for seven days and at the sight of Sudaridra, the Brahmana, remembered his past and became a Siddha him- self having anointed his son विश्वक्षेन on the throne. M. २०. २३-38; २१. १६, २४-35.
--a royal line of १०० warriors cf. जातकस्: वायु प्। ३७६ (Car. Lec. १९१८. p. ५६). M. २७३. ७२; वा. ९९. ४५४.
--a R; a महानदी in भारतवर्ष. वा. १०८. ८१.
--the day of ब्रह्मा the creator, at the end of which the वैराजस् are born as ब्रह्मवादिन्स्. M. १३. 5.
--the son of a family of hereditary Vedic teachers. वा. ८३. ५४. [page२-508+ २७]
(I)--a daughter of ब्रह्मदान, married by शण्ड. Br.
(II)--married a यक्ष, one of the two sons of खश; the hair-less. वा. ६९. १२३.
--one of the three राक्षस clans moving about in the day as against the निशाचरस्. Br.
--a राक्षस on the Vaidyuta mountain. M. १२१. १८.

. ४७-8.
worshipped by Sakarmaka-karman in पुष्करद्वीप.
4: भा. V. २०. ३२-3.

--the oneness with the ब्रह्मा;

in गया.
2: Ib. १०९. १८; १११. ४८ and ५६.
[page२-509+ २७]
--the son of Prahetu and a राक्षस, living in the वैभ्राजवन on the Sarayu; a follower of Kubera. वा. ४७. १६.
--the स्थान of ब्रह्मा in the northern portion of the निषध hill; here is the temple of Agni. वा. ४१. ५९-61.

(I)--a श्रुतऋषि: a pupil of देवदर्श;
1: Br. II. ३३. १०; ३५. ५७.
an एकार्षेय.
2: M. २००. 6.

--the sacrifice leading to मोक्ष or salva- tion. वा. १४. 5. [page२-510+ ४३]

--a class of demons: Agastyas and विस्वामित्रस् come under this group;
1: भा. X. ६३. ११; Br.

. १००; 8. ५९; ४१. २९; वा. 2. ३३.
live in the Surabhi forest;
2: M. १२१. ६२.
born in the family of ब्रह्मराक्षसिस्; generally reside in श्लेष्मातक trees.
3: वा. ६९. १३४-5.
--the period before dawn when after रासक्रीड (s.v.) the Gopis went back to their Vraja. भा. X. ३३. ३९.

. ३२; २१. ७०; २२. २०.
ब्रह्मा, Purohita at;
११: Ib. ६५. ६८ and ७७.
the last place where वैता- trika Devas went and became one with God during the Pralaya.
१२: Br.
--an account of, in the ब्रह्मवै- वर्त। M. ५३. ३५.
--He who realises the one God in the Trinity. वा. ६६. ११४; १०१. ११२.
--born of five gotras, कश्यप, वसिष्ठ, बृगु, Angiras and Atri. वा. ६१. ८१.
--in Brahmaloka; only one tree; the शरिर or body is tree and the जीव is ईश्वर. वा. 9. ११६, ११८-19.

--(Atharva) personified in the वारुनी यज्ञ;
1: Br.

. २६-30.
with cruel कृत्यविधि; with Pratyangarasayoga and with a head with two bodies.
2: वा. ६५. २७.

--Brahmavaivartam, one among the महापुराणस् and comprising १८,000 श्लोकस्; deals with [page२-512+ ३१] the Rathantarakalpa, कृष्णमाहात्म्य, and ब्रह्मवराह; narrated to नारद by सावर्णि; he who gives it on the Full Moon day of the माघ month reaches Brahmaloka. भा.
--the observance of this vow leads to निर्वाणम्। M. १०१. ४८.

--White, eternal, never failing, all per- vading (वेदान्त);
1: वा. १०१. ८६.
enjoyed by देवऋषिस्.

--Here गन्गा divides into four branches: the abode of ब्रह्मा. भा. V. १

--the tenth Manu; son of उपश्लोक; भूरिषेण and others were the ten sons; हविष्मत् and others were the sages: श्रीमूर्ति was the name of the manifestation of Hari in this epoch; शम्भु [शान्ति (वि। प्।)] was Indra. भा. VII. १३. २१-3. Vi.
--a part of the place where Linga or image is installed to the left of it. M. २६३. 3 and 6.

--a place in the Vedi where ब्रह्म- ज्योति अग्नि is located;
1: वा. २९. २१.
here is विश्वव्यच अग्नि।
2: Br. II. १२. २४.
--the property of a Brahmana which should not be confiscated by a king; Haihaya paid a penalty for taking Jamadagni's cow. Br. III. २८. ३८-50, ६८; २९. 1; ३०. 2.
--one who fails to satisfy a woman's love when requested to do so in secret, incurs the sin of; was urged by ययाति in defence of his marrying शर्मिष्ठा. M. ३२. ३३.
--near व्याससरस् once visited by अक्रूर; कृष्ण took नारद and the Gopas to this place where they saw the वेदस् chanting the praise of कृष्ण. भा. X. २८. १६-17; Br. III. १३. ५२.

(I)--पितामह, (लोकपितामह)--appeared on the lotus from the navel of Hari at the end of the Kalpa; the Lord with four faces: origin of five faces connected with his daughter and wife शतरूपा;
1: भा.

. १४; 2. ३६; 3. 1, ३७, ४०.
Born of Hari's grace: expression of रजस्: By Yoga saw the one पुरुष lying on शेष: Praised Him, who instructed him in the art of creation: nine-fold creation from प्रकृति; created the वेदस् and human society: created also a mind-born son to शम्भु who attained Brahmalokam: a second son of his, was Bhuva, who was sent to the mother--earth: the third son भूर्भुव and his son became Gopati. From his body was created गायत्री, who became his wife: then came प्रजा- patis, oceans. etc.
2: भा. I. १८. १४.

. २०.
his curses and blessings moderate.
8: M. २२. 4; १८४. २८.
A day of, is a thousand cycles of the 4 yugas; Pralaya, the night of ब्रह्मा; period of his life is द्वीपरार्ध. All the fourteen Manus flourish during his day.
9: भा. V. १६. २८.
Author of the Atharva mantras; learnt the Veda from Hari and taught it to Manu;
१०: Ib. X. ८८. १२.
his sons were मरीचि and Atri whose son was Soma. The last was made the lord of Brahmanas, stars, etc. Influenced Soma to restore तारा to बृहस्पति. Found out that Budha was Soma's son. Punished Soma as a sinful planet for enjoying तारा.
११: Ib.

. १२; M. २३. १०, ४४-6.
Presented पृथु with armour and prevented him from slaying Indra.
१४: M. २०१. १७; २२५. १२; २४९. १३, ५८.
Visited Manu and Priyavrata and addressed her on home life.
१५: भा.

.
Did not help दुर्वास pursued by the चक्र of विष्णु;
१७: Ib. XI. १३. १६-41.
was unable to answer the question of his son, Sanaka and others on the subtlity of yoga; remembered Hari who explain- ed it in the form of a Hamsa.
१८: M. १७८. ५६, ६४, ७९.
Praised विष्णु for killing काल- nemi.
१९: भा.

.
Met Hari-Ajita to restore the fortune of Indra; cursed by दुर्वास and his prayer.
२०: Ib. X. ८७. 9.
Performed यज्ञ in Janaloka;
२१: Ib. X. ८९. 3-4.
was displeased at भृगु's behaviour;
२२: Ib.

; 8. ४०; १०. २६-29, ३३; M. १६१. १७.
went with भृगु and दक्ष to हिरण्यकशिपु engaged in austerities; granted boons to him and disappeared. Was present at प्रह्लाद's coronation;
२३: Ib. १६१. १८-23.
when petitioned by the gods to show a way to get rid of हिरण्यकशिपु, suggested Hari for it. Took the form of a calf,
२४: भा. VII. १०. ६२, ७०.
when Hari in the guise of a cow went to drink the immortalising fluid in श्रीपुर; praised शिव who burnt the Tripura;
२५: M. १३३. ५२.
charioteer of त्रिपुरारि.
२६: भा. VIII. २१. 1, 3 and 5; २२. २१-3; २३. २४, २६-7.
Came to see वामन measuring the world with his two steps; washed his feet with waters; and with other Gods worshipped Him with tributes; addressed वामन-Hari; with his approval वामन was taken to Indra's capital; praised वामन's deeds and also Aditi.
२७: Ib.

.
[page२-516+ ३१] On an appeal from Mother-Earth that she had to bear a heavy burden of the Asuras, ब्रह्मा went with शिव to the shore of the milk ocean and eulogised Hari by Puru- षसूक्त; they were told of the incarnation of कृष्ण at Vasu- deva's residence; encouraged देवकी on the eve of कृष्ण's birth; came to see Hari at बृन्दावन्; was staggered at the potency of his माया and praised the Lord.
२८: Ib.

. ३३-4; X. ५२. १५ [3-११].
Suggested to Raivata that बलराम was a suitable husband for रेवती and asked him to give his daughter in marriage to him;
२९: Ib. X. ७४. १३.
attended the sacrifices of वरुण and युधिष्ठिर.
३०: Ib.

.
Went with all the Devas to द्वारका first to remind कृष्ण to go back to his eternal abode; addressed the Lord on the purpose and fulfilment of the अवतार्।
३१: Ib.

. १२.
Wondered at मार्कण्डेय's व्रत;
३२: Ib. XII. १३. १० and १९.
heard the भा- गवत पुराण from Hari.
३३: Ib.

worshipped by वालि with fire rite.

(VI)--image of; four faces and sitting on a lotus; on the swan; on either side सावित्री and सरस्वती. M. २६०. ४०; २६६. ४२; २८५. 6.

--the image of; four faces and four hands with the swan for riding. M. २६१. २४.

--(पुराणम्) one among the महा- पुराणस्; comprises १२,000 (१२, २०० म्। प्। and १२,100 वा। प्।) श्लोकस् dealing with the future kalpas; narrated by ब्रह्मा; contains a description of ब्रह्माण्ड; he who gives it with two yellow woollen garments and a golden cow in the व्यती- पात attains the merit of performing a thousand राजसूयस्. भा.

ईश्वर entered into;

was split by भण्ड.

--परशुराम was sitting in this posture while performing penance. Br. III. ५७. 6.
